name: Accelink Technologies Co., Ltd.
blurb: Accelink Technologies (SZSE: 002281), headquartered in Wuhan, Hubei, is one of China's broadest-based optoelectronic component and subsystem suppliers. The company covers the full photonics stack: transmission optical transceiver modules, optical fiber amplifiers (EDFAs), passive optical devices, smart optical devices, fixed-network access products, wireless access components, and data-communication products for data centres, enterprise networks, and storage systems. Accelink is classified as a 'second-tier CPO manufacturer' that has completed development of a 1.6T co-packaged optics engine in partnership with domestic research institutions and sent samples to overseas customers for qualification. The company appeared as a named competitor in Coherent Corp.'s 10-K filing under Photonic Solutions.
recent: Accelink's 2024 revenue was 8.27 billion CNY, up 36% year-over-year. The trailing-twelve-month revenue through Q3 2025 reached 11.43 billion CNY, up 61% year-over-year, as AI-infrastructure build-out in Chinese and global data centres drove exceptional demand for optical interconnects. The company is advancing CPO technology and actively seeking overseas design-win qualifications for its 1.6T engine.
